statements.status_notes: No upstream fix is available: the liquidjs advisory (GHSA-hh27-hf48-9f5q) lists no patched release and the latest version 10.27.0 remains affected. The date filter unbounded width padding DoS requires attacker-controlled Liquid template content. In Uptime Kuma, liquidjs renders notification message templates configured by authenticated administrators rather than anonymous attacker-controlled input. Reachability and a non-breaking mitigation are under assessment; this will be patched once liquidjs ships a fix.
